name: Wispr Flow glow
description: While you dictate with Wispr Flow, the screen edges glow in the wallpaper's colours and follow your voice, drawn on the GPU (edge gradients and voice ribbons as shaders), and bars along the bottom edge move with each word: the Kurve look by default, or rainbow, wallpaper or Caelestia, switched live with wispr-glow-style. Automatic gain on a decibel scale; errors turn the glow red and arrive as notifications; Wispr's own bottom bar stays hidden. Successor of the wispr-glow 0.1.3 bundle (edge-aura, wispr-flow, wispr-status-hidden).
